correction.ordering: summed logit penalty; then lexicographic field/slot/value edit indices
correction.stop: first strictly valid graph; unchanged valid raw graph; otherwise abstain

selection.fit_guard: no lost accepted-correct answers or new wrong acceptances on development_fit
selection.rule: All gates required. A validity-only increase cannot select the correction. Keep the raw checkpoint as control if rejected; do not open protected scoring. No post-score threshold changes.

baseline: Nearest interface/type-compatible frozen fit graph by the same embedding; graph-hash tie-break; positional alpha-renaming only; no edits to literals or algorithm.
measurement: One matched development quality pass. Capture all raw/logit predictions and all route public decisions before opening independent development tests. Charge shared inference to both neural routes. Cold setup and independent scoring separately. No protected or 2b input access.
freeze: Always record the exact evaluated candidate identity and rejected disposition. Only a passing selection is development-qualified; it is not the protected-campaign seal, which still requires the historical search baselines.
